autotest.name: Auto-test after a run
autotest.section.name: Auto-test
autotest.section.title: Auto-test after a run
autotest.section.desc: When an agent run finishes, IntelyIDE can run the unit tests of the repositories it worked in and show the result on the run.
autotest.section.enableDesc: Adds the test result to runs, the Run tests button and the palette command.
autotest.section.mode: Run the tests after a run
autotest.section.modeDesc.off: Never by itself. You can still press Run tests on a run.
autotest.section.modeDesc.ask: Asks once for each repository, naming the command, and remembers your answer.
autotest.section.modeDesc.always: After every run that changed files, in every repository you trusted. A repository is asked about once first.
autotest.section.forgetDesc: {n, plural, =0 {No repository has an answer yet.} one {# repository has an answer.} other {# repositories have an answer.}} Forgetting also removes the trust, so IntelyIDE asks again before it runs a test command.
autotest.section.forgotten: Forgotten. IntelyIDE asks again after the next run.
autotest.header.runTip: Run the unit tests of the repositories this run worked in
autotest.header.busyTip: Wait until this run and every other run on these repositories has finished. Agents may still be writing files.
autotest.chip.passedTip: All unit tests passed after this run
autotest.chip.failedTip: Some unit tests failed after this run. Open the run to see which.
autotest.chip.problemTip: The unit tests could not run or took too long. Open the run to see why.
autotest.card.title: Unit tests
autotest.card.fix: Ask the agent to fix the failing tests
autotest.card.fixTip: Opens New run with the failures in the prompt. Nothing starts until you press Start.
autotest.status.waiting: Waiting for the runs on this repository to finish
autotest.status.notTestedServer: Not tested: this run worked on a server
autotest.status.passedCount: {n, plural, one {# test passed} other {All # tests passed}}
autotest.status.failedCount: {n, plural, one {# test failed} other {# tests failed}}
autotest.ask.title: Trust this repository's test command?
autotest.ask.body: {n, plural, one {After a run that changes files, IntelyIDE can run this repository's own test command by itself:} other {After a run that changes files, IntelyIDE can run these repositories' own test commands by themselves:}}
autotest.ask.warning: It runs the repository's own scripts on this computer with your user's rights. Only say yes for a repository you trust. If the command changes, IntelyIDE asks again.
autotest.ask.note: Your answer is remembered for each repository. Settings > Auto-test can forget it.
autotest.error.changed: The test command changed since you trusted it. It did not run; the next run asks again.
autotest.prompt.intro: The unit tests failed after the last run.
autotest.prompt.noDetail: The test output had no failure details. Run the tests and read the output.
autotest.prompt.outro: Fix the code so these tests pass. Do not delete or weaken the tests. If a test itself is wrong, say why before you change it.
